title: Standard Employee Paystub
description: The standard paystub for a regular, ongoing employee. This template calculates standard withholdings (federal/state tax, FICA) and is suitable for most traditional employment relationships with a consistent schedule.

title: Standard Employee Paystub — Modern
description: The same standard employee paystub data in a modern, grayscale layout: a bold header band with your company logo, side-by-side taxes and deductions, and a prominent boxed NET PAY total. Print-optimized in black, white, and gray.

title: Earnings Statement — Classic Ruled
description: The traditional payroll form: serif type inside a hairline-ruled box, a single identity strip across the top, earnings and withholding side by side, and a closing band of year-to-date and current-period totals. Figures print without a currency symbol, the way payroll bureaus issue them.

title: Earnings Statement — Banded Panels
description: A grey-banded payroll form: an outlined company block, employee details in two columns, payment and deduction cards side by side, and year-to-date and net totals boxed at the foot. Shows the state paid family-leave premium as its own deduction line where the employee's state runs one.

title: Earnings Statement — Payroll Register
description: The payroll-register format: an indented identity head, a wide earnings and statutory-withholding ledger with deductions shown as negatives, and employee-paid benefits carried in an Other Benefits and Information panel alongside. Adds a state paid-leave line and a disbursement line naming the payment method.

title: Statement of Earnings and Deductions — Typewriter
description: A monospaced statement set in IBM Plex Mono with italic section headings, outlined employee and pay-schedule boxes, a rule-bracketed earnings and withholding ledger, and a gridded current/year-to-date summary. Adapts its earnings line to the wage type and adds a state paid-leave row where one applies.

title: Independent Contractor Invoice & Earnings Statement
description: Designed for 1099 contractors, this template functions as both an invoice for services rendered and an earnings summary. It highlights gross pay without traditional employee tax withholdings, emphasizing it is not a W-2 wage statement.

title: Temporary Assignment Paystub
description: This paystub is tailored for employees hired through a staffing agency or for a specific, short-term assignment. It may include details about the hiring agency, client company, and the assignment period.

title: Small Business Paystub — Logo Header
description: A clean two-column stub for a small business: your logo beside the employer block above a green rule, employee and pay period side by side, then pay and deductions, taxes and a boxed summary with net pay. Upload a logo on the Company step and it prints in the header; without one the employer block simply moves to the left edge.

title: Earnings Statement — Blue Panels
description: A blue-accented statement: your logo and company name at the top, gray employee and pay-period panels with a blue bar, blue-banded earnings and taxes / deductions tables side by side, and boxed year-to-date and current totals closing on a blue Net Pay band. Shows the pay schedule and payment method.

title: Pay Stub — Dark Sidebar
description: A full-height slate sidebar carries your logo, the employer, the pay period, the employee and the net pay, while the white area beside it lists earnings, taxes and deductions with this-period and year-to-date columns. One teal accent; the logo slot closes up when no logo is uploaded.

title: Statement of Earnings — Centered Letterhead
description: A formal serif statement: your logo and company name centred over a double wine-red rule, two ruled strips for the employee and the pay period, then full-width earnings, taxes and deductions ledgers that close on a gross-less-taxes-less-deductions reckoning of net pay.

title: Pay Stub — Take-Home First
description: Leads with the number the employee looks for: net pay in large green figures, then an equation strip (gross − taxes − deductions = net) and one running ledger that walks from earnings through taxes and deductions down to a green Net Pay band. Employer and employee details sit at the foot.

title: Pay Stub — Three Columns
description: Earnings, taxes and deductions as three equal navy-headed cards in a single row, each with its total directly beneath, under a navy PAY STUB block with a four-cell period strip and closing on a full-width Net Pay band. Hours and rates print on one line for hourly employees.

title: Earnings Statement — This Period & Year to Date
description: Split by time instead of by category: a white This Period panel and an indigo-tinted Year to Date panel side by side, each listing earnings, taxes and deductions and ending in its own Net Pay bar, with the rows lined up across. Your logo and company name head the page.

title: Pay Statement — Numbered Boxes
description: Laid out like a government wage form: every fact in its own ruled, captioned box, lettered for who and when and numbered for money, with this-period figures in monospaced type and the year-to-date amount beneath each. Black and gray only.

title: Pay Stub — Summary Tiles
description: Opens with four rounded tiles (gross pay, taxes, deductions and a solid teal net pay), each with its year-to-date figure, above rounded cards for earnings, taxes, deductions and the pay details. Your logo and company sit at the top left, the employee at the top right.

title: Pay Stub — Minimal
description: No boxes and no fills: black hairlines, light type and plenty of space, with the name of each part (Employer, Employee, Pay period, Earnings, Taxes, Deductions, Net pay) set in the left margin and net pay closing the page in large figures. Black and gray only.

title: Pay Slip — Compact
description: One narrow, centred slip inside a single outline, read top to bottom: employer, the particulars as label and value pairs, earnings, taxes, deductions and a boxed net pay, separated by dashed rules. Black and gray only.

title: Pay Stub — Center Spine
description: A dark spine down the middle of the page carries the employee and four boxed totals (earnings, taxes, deductions and net pay in gold) above your logo and company name, with earnings and pay details to its left and taxes and deductions to its right.

title: Pay Stub — With Counterfoil
description: A dashed perforation splits the page: the full stub on the left with your logo, earnings, taxes, deductions and net pay, and a narrow counterfoil on the right that repeats only the essentials as the record to keep. Charcoal with one red accent.

title: Pay Stub — In Duplicate
description: Two compact copies of the same stub on one sheet, an Employee Copy and an Employer Copy, separated by a dashed cut line. Each is a short ruled frame with earnings, taxes and deductions in three columns and a black net pay bar. Black and gray only.

title: Pay Stub — Four Quadrants
description: A two-by-two grid of equal, numbered boxes (1 Earnings, 2 Taxes, 3 Deductions, 4 Summary) under your logo and a tinted employee strip, so the fourth box answers the first three. Purple accent.

title: Statement of Pay — Running Balance
description: Set out like an account statement: the employee name and address in the window-envelope position, a boxed statement summary, and one ledger with Earnings and Withheld columns and a running balance that ends at net pay. Your logo heads the page; dark green accent.

title: Payroll Ledger — Green Bar
description: Drawn like columnar ledger paper: pale green bars, red-brown column rules and a single table in which every line posts its amount to the Earnings, Taxes or Deductions column, footed by a Totals line and a green Net Pay line. Monospaced figures.

title: Pay Stub — Centre Axis
description: Everything hangs from one hairline down the middle of the page, the way film credits are set: labels end at the axis, amounts start from it and year-to-date figures sit at the far right, with net pay centred in large light figures beneath. Black with a brown accent.

title: Pay Stub — Banded Totals
description: Four full-width copper bands, darkening down the page (Earnings, Taxes, Deductions, Net Pay), each carrying its own total inside the band with the detail lines beneath. Your logo and company name head the page.

title: Pay Stub — Alternating Rows
description: Each ledger shares its row with a tinted card holding its total, and the card changes sides from row to row: gross pay to the right of earnings, total taxes to the left of taxes, then deductions, closing on a full-width cyan Net Pay bar.

title: Pay Stub — Broadsheet
description: Composed like a newspaper front: the employer name as a heavy serif nameplate, a dateline between rules, then three columns of print divided by hairlines for the people and the payment, earnings and deductions, and taxes and net pay. Black only.

title: Pay Stub — Four Steps
description: Tells the pay as a path: a vertical line with numbered dots (you earned, taxes were withheld, deductions were taken, you were paid), each step showing its total beside its title and its detail beneath, ending in a tinted net pay panel. Your logo heads the page; sky blue accent.
